identification: Large unframed Rylton Viney untitled mixed media, H-137 W-122 cm per catalogue; textured arcade with arches and mask, earth and copper tones. Viney is a Tasmanian artist with a big volume of work recently through Armitage (many lots in Sept to Nov 2026), so supply is heavy.

viewing_check: Look for a signature or label on front, back and edges (Viney usually signs/titles on verso), the title and date, true dimensions, and the extent of scuffing or flaking in the textured surface. No SOLD resale evidence found in databases; the same-size Armitage group went $50 to $180, all local, so there is no resale support for a price above $200.
